## TO_JSON, TO_JSON_STRING, JSON_ARRAY and JSON_OBJECT with INTERVAL values
# Expected values: BigQuery's JSON encodings table, which encodes an INTERVAL as an ISO 8601
# duration string; GoogleSQL compliance functions_testlib_tojson.cc
# (AddIntervalValueTestCases), which agrees with it, for mixed signs and fractional seconds.
# NULL values and containers follow the table's NULL, ARRAY and STRUCT rows, and JSON_OBJECT's
# and JSON_ARRAY's values the same encodings, as BigQuery's json_functions#json_object and
# json_functions#json_array document.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(INTERVAL '10:20:30.52' HOUR TO SECOND)
=> "\"PT10H20M30.52S\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(INTERVAL 1 SECOND)
=> "\"PT1S\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(INTERVAL -25 MONTH)
=> "\"P-2Y-1M\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(INTERVAL '1 5:30' DAY TO MINUTE)
=> "\"P1DT5H30M\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(INTERVAL '1-2 -3 4:5:6' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "\"P1Y2M-3DT4H5M6S\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(INTERVAL '-12:34:56.789' HOUR TO SECOND)
=> "\"PT-12H-34M-56.789S\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(INTERVAL '-0-1 0 -0:2:0' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "\"P-1MT-2M\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(INTERVAL 0 YEAR)
=> "\"P0Y\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL))
=> "null"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING([INTERVAL 1 SECOND, NULL])
=> "[\"PT1S\",null]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(INTERVAL 1 SECOND AS i), true)
=> "{\n  \"i\": \"PT1S\"\n}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(INTERVAL -25 MONTH))
=> "\"P-2Y-1M\""

SELECT JSON_TYPE(TO_JSON(STRUCT([INTERVAL 1 SECOND] AS a)).a[0])
=> "string"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(INTERVAL 1 SECOND, stringify_wide_numbers => TRUE))
=> "\"PT1S\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT('i', INTERVAL 2 DAY, 'n', CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL)))
=> "{\"i\":\"P2D\",\"n\":null}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT(['a', 'b'], [INTERVAL -25 MONTH, INTERVAL '10:20:30.52' HOUR TO SECOND]))
=> "{\"a\":\"P-2Y-1M\",\"b\":\"PT10H20M30.52S\"}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT('s', STRUCT(INTERVAL 1 SECOND AS i), 'a', [INTERVAL 1 SECOND]))
=> "{\"a\":[\"PT1S\"],\"s\":{\"i\":\"PT1S\"}}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY(INTERVAL 2 DAY, CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL), INTERVAL -25 MONTH))
=> "[\"P2D\",null,\"P-2Y-1M\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY(STRUCT(INTERVAL 1 SECOND AS i), [INTERVAL '10:20:30.52' HOUR TO SECOND]))
=> "[{\"i\":\"PT1S\"},[\"PT10H20M30.52S\"]]"
